description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of Git pack operations, including creating multiple pack scenarios, reorganizing packs into chunks, and measuring clone performance with different reuse strategies.

methods.name: find_pack
methods.description: Searches for a pack file index containing a specific object and returns its filename.

methods.name: repack_into_n_chunks
methods.description: Reorganizes Git pack files into a specified number of chunks for performance testing.
